To proceed, please choose one option:

1) **Return both orders** and refund each to its **own original payment method**, or  
2) **Return both orders** and refund both to an **existing gift card** (tell me which gift card, if you have one).

Which option would you like?
Are you kidding me? That’s so stupid. Why can’t you just do what I asked? This is ridiculous. Fine, whatever. Just refund everything to the original payment methods.
